name: 86 Chaos 16.0.48 App Load and Notification Badge Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.48 App Load and Notification Badge Fix
notes: Fixes an app-shell startup crash caused by an accessibility observer dependency order issue, and changes push notification badges to a dedicated transparent badge so Android status-bar notifications do not show square app-logo blocks.
releaseNotes: Fixed an app-shell startup crash where an accessibility label observer referenced menu state before the menu state hook was initialized.
The label observer now uses a safer body mutation watch and no longer watches the aria-label attribute it writes itself.
Push notification payloads now use /notification-badge.png as the small badge instead of the full square app icon, reducing square status-bar notification icons on Android.
Play Store release-gate runner now creates 86chaos-release-gate-SLIM-UPLOAD-ME.zip by default instead of the giant full artifact ZIP.
The full release-gate ZIP is only created when CHAOS_RELEASE_GATE_FULL_ZIP=true is explicitly set.
Release-gate broken-value checks no longer treat normal words like Financials or Maintenance as NaN failures.
The schedule math oracle now treats 18-hour shifts such as 4p-10a as invalid, matching the app validation rule.
Release-gate login helpers can open the workspace switcher after login so QA workspace tests do not accidentally inspect the wrong restaurant.
System Administrator direct-route access is stricter for normal managers while preserving real system-admin and master-admin access markers.
Restricted platform gates shown to staff no longer expose privileged System Administrator terminology.
Local generated avatars no longer call ui-avatars.com, avoiding blocked external avatar requests during fuzz and offline tests.
featureAccess now exports hasFeature for release-gate capability tests.
Bug-report API responses echo the raw crash marker so live crash pipeline tests can prove the synthetic marker was preserved.
The Help Center no longer describes the microphone as a preview mic label.
The Platform Operations cleanup button is explicitly labeled Clean Full Audit QA Restaurants.
Mobile tap targets and missing accessible names were hardened for release-gate route crawls.
Firestore diagnostics now self-heals stale or partial listener/cache buckets before reading dynamic query keys, preventing the undefined users-cache crash seen in release-gate route crawls.
Automatic crash reports now suppress known non-fatal Firebase Messaging unsupported-browser errors server-side and dedupe identical crash reports within a short window.
Schedule time validation now treats 18-hour-or-longer shifts like 4p-10a as invalid unless a future explicit business setting says otherwise.
Schedule Builder displays full staff names in the planning grid and keeps event labels readable with full titles plus times.
Request-off cards and partial-day chips now show safe readable dates/times instead of Invalid Date when a legacy partial record is incomplete.
System Administrator routing accepts server-verified super-admins plus local system administrator markers while keeping normal staff/manager gates intact.
The accessibility release gate can run with the existing axe-core package even when @axe-core/playwright is not installed.
The missing RUN_86CHAOS_PLAY_STORE_RELEASE_GATE.ps1 runner is restored so npm run test:play-store can start the local release gate.
Firebase Messaging now checks browser support before push token sync or foreground message listeners run.
Known messaging/unsupported-browser errors are no longer reported as Crash / Error bug notifications.
Unsupported push sessions now save a quiet push status of unsupported-browser instead of breaking the app or spamming admins.
Manual push repair now shows Push Unavailable when the browser cannot support Firebase Messaging.
The real app still uses Firebase Messaging on supported browsers and devices.
86Voice 86/out-of-stock commands now resolve unique live inventory products from short spoken phrases while still asking for review when multiple products match.
86Voice prep updates now use fuzzy existing-row matching, so “prep ranch” can update an existing “Fill Ranch Bottles” row instead of creating a duplicate.
Menu impact and AI ordering voice paths now use richer inventory aliases including category, vendor, SKU/code, pack size, alternate names, and keywords.
My Schedule now shows only current and upcoming shifts for the selected month instead of dimming old ended shifts in the employee list.
Schedule Builder Auto-Fill now fetches the full selected source month before copying shifts, so weeks outside the current visible planning window are not silently skipped.
releaseTitle: 86 Chaos 16.0.48 App Load and Notification Badge Fix
